Results came out. Chemistry, 41 out of 100, again. I don't get it. I sat with the notes for five hours the night before and read every page twice, highlighting in three colours.

The next exam is in three weeks. I think I'll start earlier and reread more.
Write back soon.
Ashwin

passage: I'm Himani, Jeevan's twin. Before every exam he does the same thing. He locks himself in the study room with his notebooks and a highlighter and reads. For hours. Page after page, the same pages, three times each. Last term he did that for maths, science, everything. His marks came back: mostly in the forties. He sat on the bed staring at the report card. I said, "Why don't you try the practice questions? Close the book and see what you remember." He shook his head. "Reading is how I study." The next exam came and I heard the same pages turning, late into the night. I don't know what he felt. But the marks came back the same.
